turns.user_utterance: I would like to know how I can verify my Identity.
turns.assistant_response: Sure—do you want to know how to complete identity verification in the app, or are you stuck because verification failed?

turns.user_utterance: I just need the steps to do it in the app.
turns.assistant_response:
To verify your identity in the app, follow these steps: 
1) Open the app and go to your Profile/Settings (often under “Account”).
2) Tap “Verify identity” or “Identity verification”.
3) Choose your document type (e.g., passport or driver’s license) and confirm the country/region.
4) Take clear photos of the document (front and, if required, back) and make sure all corners are visible.
5) Complete the selfie step (liveness check) and follow the on-screen instructions.
6) Review your details and submit.

If you tell me whether you’re on Android or iPhone, I can guide you to the exact menu path.
